briefdescription.para: Class representing a grid of ground points on the surface of a celestial body.

detaileddescription.para: The Grid class manages a collection of ground points, allowing for various grid configurations such as uniform, equal area, and weighted grids. It provides methods to iterate over the ground stations and access their properties.

parameterdescription.para: The celestial body NTTP this grid resides on.
